The overseer cannot see what any job found last cycle. This is the most significant structural gap: cross-run correlation is impossible without it.

2. STUCK PENDING LEDGER RECORDS — Sessions that started but never wrote a terminal status row:

   These are likely crashes before final ledger write. Not affecting success-rate stats but creates orphaned records.

3. HEALTH-CHECK 96.7% (9 failures in 24h) — Ledger shows zero result=failure; misses are spawn-errors and timeouts. No consecutive failures, not worsening.

4. MODEL ALLOCATION — All 5 jobs appropriately use haiku. No over-allocation.

5. SCHEDULES — Reasonable: health-check 5min (critical), degradation-digest 4h, state-integrity 6h, guardian-pulse 8h, session-continuity 4h.

NEXT OVERSEER: Check if degradation-digest run mob4wgdo-7 (started 07:02) ever completed. Watch for increasing stuck-pending counts in guardian-pulse.
